newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belmont publishes special IGC jobs report.
newsitem.headline: Belmont publishes special IGC jobs report.

text.p: "Challenge", the Belmont European Policy Centre's newsletter on the inter-governmental conference (IGC), has issued a special supplement on employment and the IGC.
Among its contributors are Francois Perigot, president of UNICE, the employers' federation, and Emilio Gabaglio, general secretary of the European Trade Union Confederation.
Other special issues are being prepared on enlargement and on flexibility, Challenge said.
For further information, contact: Belmont, 42 Blvd Charlemagne, 1000 Brussels, Belgium. Tel (32 2) 231 0340.
